arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:7f2340af-df6d-4a1b-b2c2-ef96f49b8: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:a03af48b-e8d2-450d-9a9c-f4e93778f: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:5206cb49-b417-4c77-9af4-de5e61001: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:4680b5f0-bc43-4809-9fbb-b2a6318e8: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:26bd2225-e3bd-4cd9-8cf0-d8bf3219e: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
